pin_title: 6 Spooky Garden & Graveyard Halloween Decorations UK Shoppers Love
pin_title_alt: Easy Ways to Turn Your Front Garden Into a Halloween Graveyard
pin_hook: Skeletons, webs and pumpkins for an outdoor scare
pin_description: Spooky garden and graveyard Halloween decorations UK shoppers love: posable skeletons, hanging skeleton ghosts, giant spider webs, a light-up inflatable pumpkin stack and bat wall decor.
